implementation.texture_format_mapping: Xenos format IDs were cross-checked against the format enum only; no emulator runtime or rendering code is linked.
implementation.format_20: Decodes the captured 16-byte-per-4x4-block format into RGBA8 on the CPU, including both DXT alpha endpoint modes.
implementation.format_59: Decodes the captured 8-byte DXT5A alpha block and places its values in W as required by the captured One,One,One,W swizzle.
implementation.tiled_storage: Reads full 32x32 compressed-block macro-tile allocations using the captured pitch, while emitting only the active base-level texels.
implementation.device_requirements: No Vulkan compressed-texture feature is required; the path uses Vulkan 1.1-compatible RGBA8 upload and is CPU/ARM64 portable.

limitations: The regression uses synthetic compressed block bytes placed under actual captured retail descriptors. It validates parsing, padded allocation bounds, byte order, untile, and DXT alpha decoding; it does not prove the contents of the retail textures or visible parity.
